# NOVA Shader

These assets were created by CyberAgent, Inc.

Source:
https://github.com/CyberAgentGameEntertainment/NovaShader

License:
MIT
https://opensource.org/license/mit

This directory contains NOVA Shader 3.6.0 plus the `pfb_eff_heal01` particle
effect and its dependencies from `Assets/Samples/Scenes/Sample08.unity`. The
particle-system child transforms are scaled to 40% so the effect is approximately
the footprint of one square in the Masonry chess sample.
